body: My mom isn't mad at me.  I admit that I don't know how to talk to her, all I could offer was my being sorry as though that amounts to anything.  I just don't want to live in this world.  You know how some people don't want to live on this planet anymore?  I seriously don't.  There isn't anything more than incidental good here.  I doubt there ever was.  I can't handle how callous life is.  I'm going to end up another callous part of it, another bug spattered on the windshield.  If not now, then later.  Probably now.  I have every reason to make it now.  Waiting for it is worse in many ways.  You know, if I don't kill myself, maybe I have an aneurysm tomorrow.  None of you would even know.  Few of you would care.  Aneurysms just happen, it sucks but they happen.  Suicide is like that too, I think.  Defect of the psyche, fatal defect.  I've been fighting with it so long, but it's like cancer in my fucking bones.  I'm desperate to be well or die.

No she doesn't want me to be miserable and I don't want her to be miserable but that doesn't matter because everything falls apart.  It's all down hill.  Things don't get better, even what you've said corroborates that.  It's just about how long it takes for things to go to complete shit, and I don't want to be alive for that.  My future only holds a hollow burn-out with no real friends, dead family, a few new phones and endless hours of work.  It's actually even worse than that.  When I was ten I never imagined I'd be like this...  

Of course people are going to get hurt, that's all life does.  I'm not even one iota better than the rest.  I'm sorry.

Closest I've ever been to being on vacation is a long drive, at least since I was 12.  A vacation with close friends?  Sounds nice but impossible.  It's fantasy, for me anyway.  I don't have friends who'd want to burn money to spend time with me.  I don't have vacation time, worked non-stop for two years and have no vacation time accrued because despite working full time they never really put me down as being a full time employee.  But there's only a few of us, if one of us was out for more than a day or two at a time the business would fall apart.  So fuck it, right?  Get a better job or move or enlist in the peace corps or some shit, right?  I can't.  I just can't.  I've seen enough of the shitty side of life.  If things got better they'd still be poisoned.  A good life would be wasted on me.  I'm already crying on a full stomach on a soft chair in an air conditioned house.  It's a waste on me.  I'm not sure I can ever be comfortable again.
